verdict.rationale: Openness of design source is a fair axis for processors, since open-source hardware cores exist, but nothing in the evidence shows the Core Ultra 7 258V's own design, RTL, or firmware is published under an open license. The open-source OpenVINO toolkit is separate companion software, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
